```yaml
name: Gitbook Docs Release

on:
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      tag:
        description: 'Release tag to process (e.g., v3.3.9)'
        required: true
        type: string

env:
  GITBOOK_API_URL: "https://api.gitbook.com"
  GITBOOK_SPACE_ID: ${{ secrets.GITBOOK_SPACE_ID }}
  GITBOOK_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITBOOK_TOKEN }}

jobs:
  sync-gitbook:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'release' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.event.inputs.tag != '')
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Extract version components
        id: version
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "workflow_dispatch" ]]; then
            TAG="${{ github.event.inputs.tag }}"
          else
            TAG="${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}"
          fi
          
          # Extract major.minor version
          MAJOR_MINOR=$(echo "$TAG" | sed -E 's/v([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)\.[0-9]+/\1.\2/')
          
          # Extract major version
          MAJOR=$(echo "$TAG" | sed -E 's/v([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)\.[0-9]+/\1/')
          
          # Extract minor version
          MINOR=$(echo "$TAG" | sed -E 's/v([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)\.[0-9]+/\2/')
          
          # Check if this is a x.y.0 release
          IS_X_Y_0=false
          if [[ "$TAG" == *"."$MINOR"."$MINOR ]]; then
            IS_X_Y_0=true
          fi
          
          echo "tag=$TAG" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "major_minor=$MAJOR_MINOR" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "is_x_y_0=$IS_X_Y_0" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create or update docs branch
        run: |
          TAG="${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}"
          MAJOR_MINOR="${{ steps.version.outputs.major_minor }}"
          
          # Create or update the docs branch
          git checkout -B "docs/v${MAJOR_MINOR}" "${TAG}"
          git push origin "docs/v${MAJOR_MINOR}" --force

      - name: Create Gitbook variant
        if: steps.version.outputs.is_x_y_0 == 'true'
        run: |
          TAG="${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}"
          MAJOR_MINOR="${{ steps.version.outputs.major_minor }}"
          
          # Format variant name
          VARIANT_NAME="V${MAJOR_MINOR} - Rocky Romp"
          
          # Create variant via Gitbook API
          curl -X POST "${{ env.GITBOOK_API_URL }}/spaces/${{ env.GITBOOK_SPACE_ID }}/variants" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ env.GITBOOK_TOKEN }}" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d '{
              "name": "'"$VARIANT_NAME"'",
              "slug": "v'"$MAJOR_MINOR"'",
              "source": {
                "type": "git",
                "repository": "github.com/erigontech/erigon",
                "branch": "docs/v'"$MAJOR_MINOR"'"
              }
            }'
```
